description: mod-courses configuration template per ADR-0013. Resource, replica, and JVM defaults match the published Trillium (R1 2026) Bugfest baseline: https://folio-org.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/REL/pages/1034125338 (reference workload: 3 standalone tenants and 11 consortia tenants). A complete Bugfest environment-variable and Kong-timeout baseline could not be found; those defaults come from the existing ModuleDescriptor, RMB 36.0.0 / Vert.x defaults, and the implementation guide. Empty sidecarDefaults arrays are included solely because both schema attachments on FOLIO-4575 require that block, despite the guide specifying only moduleDefaults for regular modules; no sidecar configuration is prescribed here.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: Container CPU allocation in CPU units, matching the Bugfest table's default for other modules and sidecars.

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Container memory hard limit in MiB, matching the published Bugfest sizing for mod-courses.

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Container memory reservation in MiB, matching the published Bugfest sizing for mod-courses.

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size, matching the published Bugfest sizing and the JAVA_OPTIONS entry.

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size, matching the published Bugfest sizing and the JAVA_OPTIONS entry.

deployment.description: The module stores persistent state in PostgreSQL and supports multiple instances for high availability; two replicas match the published Bugfest baseline.

kong.description: Guide fallback timeouts, not verified Bugfest values; the 120-second read allowance accommodates list expansion involving synchronous requests to other modules.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL writer hostname supplied by the deployment; the driver's localhost fallback is unsuitable as a deployment default.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL writer port, matching the existing ModuleDescriptor and the driver's default.

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL administrative username supplied by the deployment for tenant schema management.

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL administrative password supplied through deployment secret management.

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name supplied by the deployment for module tenant schemas.

EnvVars.name: DB_QUERYTIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Query timeout in milliseconds retained from the existing ModuleDescriptor, effective only when application code passes it to RMB query methods, which mod-courses does not currently do.

EnvVars.name: DB_CHARSET
EnvVars.description: Legacy database charset setting retained from the existing ModuleDescriptor and accepted by RMB's configuration mapper.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per tenant per database pool in each module instance, retained from the existing ModuleDescriptor rather than RMB's default of 4.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST_READER
EnvVars.description: Optional synchronous PostgreSQL reader hostname used with DB_PORT_READER, otherwise reads use the writer pool.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT_READER
EnvVars.description: Optional synchronous PostgreSQL reader port used with DB_HOST_READER, otherwise reads use the writer pool.

EnvVars.name: DB_SERVER_PEM
EnvVars.description: Optional PEM trust certificate or chain that enables PostgreSQL TLSv1.3 with server certificate and hostname verification, otherwise RMB uses an unencrypted connection.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Optional shared connection-pool limit that overrides DB_MAXPOOLSIZE across tenants; leave unset because RMB 36.0.0 documents shared pooling as buggy (RMB-1030).

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Idle connection timeout in milliseconds, matching RMB's default, with 0 keeping idle connections open indefinitely.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum connection lifetime in milliseconds before closure when idle, matching RMB's 30-minute default, with 0 disabling the limit.

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Maximum retries after a database connection failure, matching the Vert.x default of no retries.

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTINTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Delay in milliseconds between database connection retries when DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS enables them, matching the Vert.x default.

EnvVars.name: DB_EXPLAIN_QUERY_THRESHOLD
EnvVars.description: Query duration threshold in milliseconds for RMB EXPLAIN ANALYZE logging on supported query methods, matching RMB's default.

EnvVars.name: DB_ALLOW_SUPPRESS_OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING
EnvVars.description: Timestamp before which RMB permits optimistic-locking suppression for tables configured with failOnConflictUnlessSuppressed, with the default keeping suppression disabled.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options passed by the container launcher, matching the published Bugfest heap and metaspace sizing documented in the java section.

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: Optional Log4j configuration file location overriding discovery of the bundled logging configuration.
